entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, uh, I need to return something. My VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller. Order number is VF7855-1225. I'm just so disappointed.

Okay, Sarah, I have your account pulled up. I see the VeloBand was delivered 21 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken, I just... I find it so `hard to use`. The whole menu system is incredibly `confusing`. I've read the `user manual` cover to cover, and it's just not clicking. Honestly, I `expected more` clarity from a VeloFit product.
I've been a loyal customer for years, and I saved up for this. I feel awful, but I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to be the right fit for my training.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with it, Sarah. I understand completely. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I've consulted our policy, and it looks like items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 21, you are unfortunately outside that window. We can definitely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not a problem at all. I'm happy I could get this sorted out. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. Thank you again, you've been a huge help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
